t: You have heard reports of a $(thing)villager/$ who stocks some interesting $(pncr) components. Apparently he was involved in an accident with a $(l:manufacturing/pressure_chamber)Pressure Chamber/$? Anyway, these days he prefers to hang out in his own house, which can be found in villages. Failing that, a $(l:machines/charging_station)Charging Station/$ may prove enticing to unemployed villagers...
你听说过一位$(thing)村民/$，他会储备一些有趣的$(#228)气动工艺$()组件。显然，他似乎曾卷入过一场与$(l:manufacturing/pressure_chamber)压力室/$有关的事故？总之，如今他更喜欢待在自己的房子里，而这样的房子可以在村庄中找到。要是找不到的话，$(l:machines/charging_station)充气站/$或许能吸引那些失业的村民……
